journal_entries.description: December 31 period-end adjusting entry to record current and deferred income taxes

notes: Taxable income = 360,000 + 35,000 warranty accrual - 40,000 excess tax depreciation - 5,000 muni interest + 8,000 officer life insurance + 24,000 prepaid rent reversal = 382,000. Ending DTL 8,400 = 5,040 beginning - 5,040 settlement of the prepaid-rent difference + 8,400 origination on excess tax depreciation; ending DTA 7,350 = 35,000 warranty x 21%. Deferred portion of the December 31 entry is a net benefit of 3,990 (DTL up 3,360, DTA up 7,350), so total tax expense is 80,220 - 3,990 = 76,230. Part (e): DTA 7,350 and DTL 8,400 are the same component and jurisdiction, so they are offset and shown as one noncurrent net deferred tax liability of 1,050 (all deferred taxes are noncurrent under ASC 740). Effective rate 76,230/360,000 = 21.18%.
